Error in Math.factor(1L) : ‘round’ not meaningful for factors
In addition: Warning message:
In read.table(file = file, header = header, sep = sep, quote = quote,  :
  incomplete final line found by readTableHeader on '/Users/xxx.csv'

And you should use sleeplogidnum = FALSE, because your person identifiers include letter.
